capabilities: Render vertical and horizontal timelines from code blocks
Display book, music, and movie information cards with cover images
Create photo albums with optional waterfall layouts
Insert countdowns, business cards, highlight blocks, and content subfields
Draw SWOT analyses and BCG quadrant diagrams
extras: Free; the author accepts donations via 'buy me a coffee'. Supports Obsidian Mobile, English and Chinese, local images, and custom codeblock languages; cards can be colored with preset or custom color tags. Bug reports are handled mainly on GitHub.
problem: Plain Markdown and built-in callouts offer no card-style visual components for timelines, media info, albums, or framework diagrams in notes.
summary: Code-block plugin that renders Markdown content as styled cards: timelines, book/music/movie info cards, photo albums, countdowns, and SWOT or BCG matrices.
